intent: Canonical material state transitions, not activity or planned work.

events.title: A finite quotient-preservation verifier gained recorded test evidence
events.change: The owner-local packet now includes executable synthetic quotient/congruence checks, recorded outputs, and an explicit prior-art crosswalk.
events.consequence: A bounded verifier makes violations and repair obligations inspectable; it does not prove the wider epistemic-factorization hypothesis.
events.claimCeiling: Internal synthetic calibration of existing mathematical criteria; no independent validation, generalized theorem or novelty admission.

events.title: The Boundary Executor became an explicit research candidate
events.change: An owner-local machine-design packet now records interface obligations, research ownership, provenance and tests still required.
events.consequence: The Lab gained a concrete object to critique or implement, not an operational general executor.
events.claimCeiling: Proposed, unimplemented, unverified; no new registered Lab Machine or validated computation capability.

events.title: The Observatory joined the canonical public website
events.change: The existing web main revision introduced a public inspection hub grouping maps, evidence, research machinery, time and institutional entry points.
events.consequence: Visitors gained a route for inspection without promoting the website above the source owner.
events.claimCeiling: Public interface change; not a claim that every Lab record or research result is publicly accessible or verified.
